scope: pre-Stage0 nonformal runtime-v2 implementation probes only

F4.ordered_gate: do not run A/B/C or natural programs unless common-X passes

count_semantics.feasibility_query_count: one family-level static/geometry audit entry plus explicit planner preflights
count_semantics.planner_query_count: every left/right move_to_pose query and every nonexecuting planner preflight
count_semantics.execution_attempt_count: one scene rollout that begins physical family actions
count_semantics.recovery_attempt_count: zero; no automated recovery in this proposal

terminal_rules: GPU precheck snapshot failure -> failed_gpu_precheck without child launch
postcheck snapshot failure or memory/utilization/processes not returning to baseline -> failed_cleanup_uncertain and stop GPU0
cleanup uncertainty or orphan -> failed_cleanup_uncertain and stop GPU0
F4 common failure -> ordered stop before later blocks
